outcomes.gate_5_additivity_with_the_baseline: MISSED: with E0 added back the additivity is 0.3121 at (0.05, 0.05) and 0.3310 at (0.05, 0.045), the committed measure's 0.3122 and 0.3311 to the fourth place (band [0, 0.05]). The reading is the composition's own error against the finer MRS: in R_yy, the squeeze both contacts share (-0.312 and -0.331), then the rotations' diagonals (-0.12 to -0.13, +0.11, -0.08 to -0.10), each one-contact error under 0.07 on the same scale. The per-body lift composes nearer additive (0.192 and 0.228, its R_yy -0.19 and -0.23) and nearer the reference (0.290 and 0.326 against the lift's 0.410 and 0.429); one at a time 0.707 at (0.05, 0.045) and NaN at (0.05, 0.05); the subtraction NaN at both. Against a finer model of the same family, whose own resolution at these gaps (0.75 to 0.83 of its spacing) is in the measurement: it bounds the coarse rung's composition against that model, never hardware
outcomes.measure_check: the measure's structure checked on a known answer independent of this run (tests/oracles/test_elliptic_gates.py::test_the_additivity_measure_on_an_exactly_additive_model): for an exactly additive model with a no-contact error B the committed measure reads B's worst entry and the measure with B added back reads zero to rounding; at this case B is 0.0003, so the two measures agree
